disposition: Historical core-model overlaps have been replaced; W059 elastic Rayleigh and O060 finite-energy Airy beam screened distinct from prior waves/optics models. Current draft 24/50, independent human expert review pending.

new_draft_model_screening.core_model: f-plane rotating shallow water with Coriolis-induced Poincare dispersion, geostrophic zero mode and coastal Kelvin localization
new_draft_model_screening.difference: W039 is parametric oscillator; W043 is background-current shallow water; W048 is gravity-capillary dispersion; W054 is bathymetry-step transmission. None has rotating geostrophic PV and coastal trapped Kelvin eigenmode.

new_draft_model_screening.core_model: spatially varying optical director q-plate with spin-to-orbital Pancharatnam-Berry phase, angular momentum and mechanical torque
new_draft_model_screening.difference: O036/O051 concern uniform retarder Jones matrices; O044 is scalar sinusoidal phase grating; O020 is scalar Fourier diffraction. None addresses spatial half-integer director winding, helicity-flip OAM, q-dependent optical torque and analyzer petal topology.

new_draft_model_screening.core_model: quantized Jaynes--Cummings cavity with excitation-number-resolved dressed doublets, Poissonian collapse/revival and dispersive atom-cavity conditional phase
new_draft_model_screening.difference: Q011/Q024/Q056 are semiclassically driven two-level Rabi models with a fixed coupling; Q016 treats a free oscillator coherent state; Q014 studies a frequency quench. None contains the quantized cavity square-root photon-number splitting, Poisson-weighted revival or dispersive cavity-state overlap.

new_draft_model_screening.core_model: continuum 1D Dirac mass kink with exact chiral zero mode, supersymmetric Pöschl--Teller partner factorization, reflectionless Dirac scattering and exact uniform chiral-breaking mass shift
new_draft_model_screening.difference: Q047 is a discrete SSH hopping chain with edge winding and no continuum Dirac scattering or SUSY partner spectrum; Q053 concerns scalar Klein--Gordon wave packets; Q044 a periodic delta potential; Q048 hard-sphere s-wave scattering. Q060 derives an exact kink continuum scattering S-matrix and gap shift not present in those models.

new_draft_model_screening.core_model: Schwarzschild spacetime timelike and null geodesics: ISCO, proper versus coordinate epicyclic frequency, photon capture and local Lorentz plus gravitational frequency shift
new_draft_model_screening.difference: M033 is Newtonian power-law central-force precession; M035 is Hohmann transfer; M043 Newtonian restricted three-body Lagrange stability; M046 classical spinning top. None uses curved-spacetime Killing constants, null photon sphere or relativistic ISCO.

new_draft_model_screening.core_model: 2D dissipative and Hall surface-conductivity Maxwell boundary scattering, reflection-transmission Jones matrices, exact passivity optimum and asymmetric dielectric substrate Faraday rotation
new_draft_model_screening.difference: E022 is bulk Drude Hall bar with open-circuit transport, E040 treats free-space Stokes parameters, E061 propagating bulk magnetoplasma eigenmodes, and Q031 Landau-level quantized DC Hall conductance. None derives radiative boundary jumps, sheet absorption optimum or substrate scattering.

new_draft_model_screening.core_model: Onsager-symmetric two-current thermoelectric generator with coupled charge/heat flux, determinant positivity, load-optimized power versus efficiency, Seebeck-Peltier Kelvin reciprocity and thermal leakage figure of merit ZT
new_draft_model_screening.difference: T030/T055 optimize finite-rate heat-exchanger temperature drops, T047 is a Jarzynski Brownian work protocol, T058 is a three-state stochastic ring current fluctuation model, E022 is a bulk Drude Hall bar. None uses reciprocal thermoelectric cross coefficients, the Onsager determinant or electrical load impedance to derive the ZT efficiency frontier.

new_draft_model_screening.core_model: Rayleigh elastic half-space surface eigenspectrum with coupled longitudinal and shear displacement potentials, uniqueness of traction-free wave speed and depth-integrated elastic energy velocity
new_draft_model_screening.difference: W021/W042 use Euler-Bernoulli beam fourth-order dynamics, W047 fluid gravity-capillary interface instability, W058 Coriolis shallow-water Kelvin trapped mode; none has elastodynamic P/SV coupling and Rayleigh traction determinant.

new_draft_model_screening.core_model: Exact finite-energy Airy paraxial beam solution from cubic Fourier phase with Gaussian spectral amplitude, accelerating caustic but stationary Ehrenfest centroid and transverse Poynting-like flux
new_draft_model_screening.difference: Prior Gaussian-lens / chirped-Gaussian models have quadratic spectral phases, while O058 is knife-edge Fresnel diffraction; none derives cubic-phase Airy propagation, norm and centroid against curved main-lobe trajectory.
